name: seal
behavior: Flaps toward the nearest player at 4.0 u/s (pursuit ceiling 0.60 - never above 5.4 u/s while flapping); between 4 u and 12 u it stops and telegraphs for 0.75 s (dashed red 3D line fixed from its body centre through the player's centre), barks on tick 0 of the dash and dashes 20 u in 1.0 s along the fixed line, then idles 0.75 s. Contact at any time = kill.
counter_play: jump on the bark, or stand a 3 HU step above/below the line, or sidestep ≥ 0.7 u on a 2-wide path or platform. Pup Pack's counter-play text is "jump each bark" — its second seal runs its own fixed line 0.5 s later, and seals capped at 3 with stagger (SR-3) keep the barks from coinciding.
tell: telegraph 0.75 s (dashed 3D line, mouth-open frame) → bark on tick 0 of the dash
